description.text: Our principal sectors of activity are: entrepreneurship capacity building, impact investment, community & events execution, market insights, program management, innovation advisory and talent development across all tech-enabled industries and emerging market geographies.

targetApplicants.text: Support emerging market entrepreneurs across various impactful verticals with capacity building and a data-driven approach.
